summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K covering a press release dated August 28, 2026, disclosing routine transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities (PDMRs). Specifically, non-executive director Serpil Timuray and her closely associated person acquired 49 ordinary shares each at £42.890887 per share through reinvestment of dividend income, totaling £2,101.65 per person, on the London Stock Exchange on August 19, 2026. This is a standard PDMR notification, not a special situation. There are no strategic actions, deals, or material corporate events. Investors should treat this as routine compliance disclosure with no market impact or actionable angle.
